data.nominating_party_note: Greeley was nominated for President by both the Liberal Republicans and the Democrats. He died on November 29, 1872, before the electors met. After his death, electors in several states split their votes.

provenance.ec_source_name: U.S. National Archives and Records Administration
provenance.redistributable_note: Redistributable data only. Electoral-college figures come from the U.S. National Archives and Records Administration — Public domain (a work of the U.S. Government, 17 U.S.C. § 105) — and cover every election in the snapshot. Popular-vote figures come from MIT Election Lab under CC0 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication) and cover 1976–2024 only; earlier elections carry no popular vote on this surface, and each row's `pv_status` says whether that is because none was held or because no redistributable source reaches it. Per-capita population figures come from the U.S. Census Bureau — Public domain (a work of the U.S. Government, 17 U.S.C. § 105). Nominating parties come from the same Electoral College source, or, where a row's `nominating_party_source` is `USGOV`, from U.S. Government publications — Public domain (a work of the U.S. Government, 17 U.S.C. § 105). Non-redistributable UCSB / American Presidency Project data is excluded from this public API surface.
